template.template_name_zh: Vastbase G100 默认巡检模板
template.description: 海量数据库 Vastbase G100（openGauss/PostgreSQL 兼容系）巡检模板。Vastbase 以标准 pg_catalog/pg_stat_* 暴露 PG 系统视图，运行时参数通过 SHOW 获取，SQL 即标准 PG 写法

chapters.description: 版本 / 实例信息 / 启动时间

queries.query_sql: SELECT version()
SELECT current_database() AS database_name, current_user AS current_user, inet_server_addr() AS server_addr, inet_server_port() AS server_port, version() AS version
queries.query_description_zh: 当前库 / 用户 / 服务地址与端口

queries.query_sql: SELECT pg_postmaster_start_time() AS startup_time, now() - pg_postmaster_start_time() AS uptime
queries.query_description_zh: 实例启动时间与运行时长

chapters.description: 连接分布 / 活跃会话

queries.query_sql: SELECT state, count(*) AS conn_count FROM pg_catalog.pg_stat_activity GROUP BY state ORDER BY conn_count DESC
SELECT pid, usename, application_name, client_addr, state, query FROM pg_catalog.pg_stat_activity

chapters.description: 全部运行时参数 / 关键内存参数

queries.query_sql: SHOW ALL
SHOW shared_buffers

chapters.description: 库大小 / 写入器统计 / 库级统计

queries.query_sql: SELECT datname AS db_name, pg_database_size(datname) AS total_bytes FROM pg_catalog.pg_database ORDER BY total_bytes DESC
SELECT * FROM pg_catalog.pg_stat_bgwriter
SELECT datname, numbackends, xact_commit, xact_rollback, blks_read, blks_hit, tup_returned, tup_fetched FROM pg_catalog.pg_stat_database

chapters.description: 表体积 / 表统计 / 索引使用

queries.query_sql: SELECT n.nspname AS schemaname, c.relname, c.relpages*8192 AS total_bytes FROM pg_catalog.pg_class c JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON c.relnamespace=n.oid WHERE c.relkind='r' AND n.nspname NOT IN ('pg_catalog','information_schema','pg_toast','snapshot','cstore') ORDER BY total_bytes DESC LIMIT 50
queries.query_description_zh: 用户表体积 TOP50（relpages*8192 估算，块大小假设 8KB）
queries.query_description_en: Top 50 user tables by estimated size

queries.query_sql: SELECT schemaname, relname, n_live_tup, n_dead_tup, last_vacuum, last_autovacuum FROM pg_catalog.pg_stat_user_tables
queries.query_description_zh: 表存活/死元组与清理时间

queries.query_sql: SELECT schemaname, relname, indexrelname, idx_scan, idx_tup_read, idx_tup_fetch FROM pg_catalog.pg_stat_user_indexes
SELECT locktype, database, relation, pid, mode, granted FROM pg_catalog.pg_locks
SELECT a.pid, a.usename, a.query, l.locktype, l.mode FROM pg_catalog.pg_locks l JOIN pg_catalog.pg_stat_activity a ON l.pid = a.pid WHERE NOT l.granted
SELECT rolname, rolcanlogin, rolsuper, rolcreaterole, rolcreatedb FROM pg_catalog.pg_roles ORDER BY rolname
queries.query_description_zh: 数据库角色清单（Vastbase 收紧 pg_authid 权限，改用 pg_roles）

queries.query_sql: SHOW password_encryption_type
queries.query_description_zh: 密码加密方式（Vastbase 为 password_encryption_type，0=md5 弱加密）

queries.query_sql: SHOW wal_level
SHOW archive_mode
SELECT * FROM pg_catalog.pg_stat_replication
